rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when someone communicates in an unclear or deliberately vague way.

example.english: You always speak obscurely, leaving me unsure what you mean.
example.traditional: 你講嘢成日含含糊糊咁，搞到我唔知你想點。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 ham4 ham4 wu4 wu4 gam3 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 m4 zi1 nei5 soeng2 dim2

rows.note: Use this when something is perceived, remembered, or described indistinctly rather than when someone is being verbally evasive.

example.english: I obscurely remember seeing this place when I was little.
example.traditional: 我仲模模糊糊咁記得細個見過呢個地方。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 mou4 mou4 wu4 wu4 gam3 gei3 dak1 sai3 go3 gin3 gwo3 nei1 go3 dei6 fong1
